explanation: R14 says an inactive user who logs in gets 403 "Inactive user". On the running app, the generated scenario got 401 "Incorrect email or password" instead, so the app does not tell the two cases apart.

rejected_citations.reason: no such scenario in the spec

verified.detail: app answered 401 {"detail": "Incorrect email or password"}; the spec says 403 {"detail": "Inactive user"}
